source: wago.tools DB2 wowf 1.60.1.70790 with hotfixes, plus the Forever client hotfix cache (build 70862, 5,223 records)

talents.name: Deadly Aspects
ranks: While Aspect of the Hawk is active, Auto Shot has a 10% chance of increasing ranged attack speed by 30% for 12 sec. While Aspect of the Beast is active, all melee auto attacks have a 10% chance of increasing melee attack speed by 30% for 12 sec.

talents.name: Endurance Training
ranks: Increases the Health and Armor of your pets by 15%.

talents.name: Improved Eyes of the Beast
ranks: Increases the duration of your Eyes of the Beast by 30 sec.
Increases the duration of your Eyes of the Beast by 60 sec.

talents.name: Improved Aspect of the Monkey
ranks: Increases the Dodge bonus of your Aspect of the Monkey by 4%. Additionally, your pet gains 50% of the effect of your Aspect of the Monkey ability.

talents.name: Thick Hide
ranks: Increases the Armor of your pets by 30%.

talents.name: Improved Revive Pet
ranks: Revive Pet's casting time is reduced by 6 sec, mana cost is reduced by 40%, and increases the health your pet returns with by an additional 30%.

talents.name: Pathfinding
ranks: Increases the speed bonus of your Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack by 6%.

talents.name: Bestial Swiftness
ranks: Increases the movement speed of your pets by 30%.

talents.name: Unleashed Fury
ranks: Increases the damage done by your pets and hawks by 20%.

talents.name: Improved Mend Pet
ranks: Gives your Mend Pet spell a 50% chance of cleansing 1 Curse, Disease, Magic, or Poison effect from your pet each time it heals and reduces the Mana cost by 20%.

talents.name: Ferocity
ranks: Increases the critical strike chance of your pets and hawks by 16%.

talents.name: Spirit Bond
ranks: While your pet is active, you and your pet will regenerate 1% of total health every 5 sec.

talents.name: Intimidation
ranks: Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.

talents.name: Bestial Discipline
ranks: Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by 100% and allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.name: Frenzy
ranks: Gives your pet a 20% chance to gain a 30% attack speed increase for 8 sec after dealing a critical strike.

talents.name: Bestial Wrath
ranks: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.

talents.name: Improved Concussive Shot
ranks: Gives your Concussive Shot a 0% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

talents.name: Efficiency
ranks: Reduces the Mana cost of your Shots, Stings, and melee abilities by 15%.

talents.name: Improved Hunter's Mark
ranks: Increases the Ranged Attack Power bonus of your Hunter's Mark spell by 3%.

talents.name: Lethal Attacks
ranks: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by 1%.

talents.name: Aimed Shot
ranks: An aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 40. Aimed Shot shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot.

talents.name: Improved Arcane Shot
ranks: Reduces the cooldown of your Arcane Shot by 1.5 sec. Does not affect the cooldown of abilities which share a cooldown with Arcane Shot.

talents.name: Hawk Eye
ranks: Increases the range of your ranged weapons by 6 yards.

talents.name: Improved Serpent Sting
ranks: Increases the damage done by your Serpent Sting by 10%.

talents.name: Mortal Shots
ranks: Increases the critical strike damage bonus on all ranged abilities by 30%.

talents.name: Scatter Shot
ranks: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.

talents.name: Barrage
ranks: Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by 15%.

talents.name: Ranged Weapon Specialization
ranks: Increases the damage you deal with ranged weapons by 5%.

talents.name: Trueshot Aura
ranks: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party or raid members within 45 yards by 50. Lasts 30 min.

talents.name: Improved Tracking
ranks: While tracking Beasts, Demons, Dragonkin, Elementals, Giants, Humanoids, or Undead, all damage you deal to the tracked creature type is increased by 5%.
Increases all damage caused against Beasts, Giants and Dragonkin targets by 2% and increases critical damage caused against Beasts, Giants and Dragonkin targets by an additional 2%.
Increases all damage caused against Beasts, Giants and Dragonkin targets by 3% and increases critical damage caused against Beasts, Giants and Dragonkin targets by an additional 3%.

talents.name: Humanoid Slaying
ranks: Increases all damage caused against Humanoid targets by 1% and increases critical damage caused against Humanoid targets by an additional 1%.
Increases all damage caused against Humanoid targets by 2% and increases critical damage caused against Humanoid targets by an additional 2%.
Increases all damage caused against Humanoid targets by 3% and increases critical damage caused against Humanoid targets by an additional 3%.

talents.name: Deflection
ranks: Increases your Parry chance by 5%.

talents.name: Entrapment
ranks: When your traps are triggered, all affected targets are Entrapped, preventing them from moving for 5 sec.

talents.name: Savage Strikes
ranks: Increases the critical strike chance of all your melee abilities by 20%.

talents.name: Improved Wing Clip
ranks: Gives your Wing Clip ability a 20% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

talents.name: Clever Traps
ranks: Increases the duration of Freezing and Frost trap effects by 30% and the damage of Immolation and Explosive trap effects by 30%.

talents.name: Survivalist
ranks: Increases your total Health by 10%.

talents.name: Deterrence
ranks: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.

talents.name: Survival Tactics
ranks: Increases your chance to hit with your Trap and Feign Death abilities by 17%.

talents.name: Surefooted
ranks: Increases your hit chance by 3% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects on you by 30%.

talents.name: Improved Feign Death
ranks: Reduces the chance your Feign Death ability will be resisted by 2%.
Reduces the chance your Feign Death ability will be resisted by 4%.

talents.name: Killer Instinct
ranks: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by 3%.

talents.name: Counterattack
ranks: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 26 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

talents.name: Lightning Reflexes
ranks: Increases your Agility by 15%.
